reference: owner request: publish 0.7.1 without a locally pushed tag
placement: Release automation only. publish.yml gains a workflow_dispatch path (inputs: version, full commit SHA) that fails closed — the commit is on main, its package.json carries the version, the tag is absent or already at that commit, and the commit's push CI run succeeded — then creates and pushes the annotated tag v<version> with GITHUB_TOKEN and publishes from that tag in the same run, inside publish.yml so npm Trusted Publishing's binding to the workflow file holds. The tag-push path is unchanged apart from skipping an already-published version and creating the GitHub release. The release procedure is documented in README.md and the agent sandbox notes in CLAUDE.md. No source, contract, test or other guardrail change.
